title: Activity
description: What has happened in this group, newest first: who joined, who answered a settlement run, and what was invited. There is no separate history table behind this - each row is read from the record it came from, so the feed cannot drift from the thing it describes.
empty: Nothing has happened yet. Every membership, answer and invitation in this group will appear here.
decisionRecorded: A member answered a settlement run: {decision}. The record says which member and not what the group calls them, so this line names nobody.
invitationCreated: An invitation code was created - spent {uses} of {max} times.
invitationCreatedUnbounded: An invitation code was created, with no limit on how often it can be spent - spent {uses} time(s) so far.
